payload.body: You tend to stay up scrolling, watching, drinking, or daydreaming when the life you have does not resemble the one you want. The distraction changes the feeling for a while but leaves the desire just as vague the next day. This often happens because admitting the want would require a decision or expose it to judgment. Write down the specific change you are avoiding when you return to the fantasy.
